```{r}
#| label: load-packages-data
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(janitor)
```

```{r}
#| label: cps-pi-overlap
frequencies_cps <- read_excel("Frequencies PI and Cxn.xlsx")
frequencies_cps_copy <- read_excel("Frequencies PI and Cxn to CPS - Copy.xlsx")
frequencies_cps_copy2 <- read_excel("Frequencies PI and Cxn to CPS - Copy2 (3).xlsx")

frequencies_copy <- clean_names(frequencies_cps_copy)
frequencies_cps <- clean_names(frequencies_cps)
frequencies_copy2 <- clean_names(frequencies_cps_copy2)
```

```{r}
#| label: graph-
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 4
frequencies_pivoted <- frequencies_copy2 |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(overall, men, women, white, black, hispanic),
               names_to = "demographic",
               values_to = "proportion") |>
  filter(!is.na(proportion)) |>
  mutate(race = case_when(
    demographic %in% c("white", "black", "hispanic") ~ demographic,
    TRUE ~ "overall"
  ),
  gender = case_when(demographic %in% c("men", "women") ~ demographic,
                     TRUE ~ "overall")) |>
  select(-demographic)

frequencies_pivoted |>
  ggplot(aes(x = proportion, y = clean_name, 
             color = race, shape = gender)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, 
             position = position_jitter(height = .2), 
             show.legend = TRUE) +
  facet_wrap(~denominator, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_bw() +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(
    override.aes = list(shape = 21, color = "black"))) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = label_wrap_gen((width = 25))) +
  xlim(0, 0.75) +
  labs(title = "CPS and Parental Incarceration",
       x = "Proportion of Total Population",
       y = "Condition")
```
